claim: The TWC Emergency Medical Response Service Staffing Program gives grants to DSHS-licensed EMS providers to fund scholarships, including for trainees pursuing EMT-Basic (not only current employees); it covers tuition and NREMT fees if passed, excludes books and uniforms, and its latest listed application window was Sept 1 - Oct 31, 2026 for courses starting after Jan 1, 2027.

evidence.quote: This program provides grants to Texas Department of State Health Services (DSHS) licensed EMS providers (firms) to fund scholarships for individuals and employees pursuing careers as Emergency Medical Technicians (EMTs) at the Basic, Advanced, and Paramedic levels.
TWC will accept applications starting September 1, 2026 – October 31, 2026, at 5:00 PM Central Daylight Time (CT). Course start dates must begin after January 1, 2027.
It also excludes equipment, books, student uniforms, and lab coats.
